exposure: Mg transport-related protein mRNA expression (TRPM6, TRPM7)
cohort: Placentas from 67 mothers, including both singleton and twin pregnancies, from relatively healthy women.
finding: TRPM6 and TRPM7 mRNAs were positively associated with placental weight in twins and TRPM7 mRNA was positively associated with placental Mg concentration in singletons, while maternal and cord blood serum Mg were not associated with placental mRNA expression.
cross-section timing: At birth/delivery, based on placental collection.
